newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian army to upgrade armoured vehicles.
newsitem.headline: Australian army to upgrade armoured vehicles.

text.p: The Australian Army proceeded this week with a programme to upgrade its armoured personnel carriers, awarding contracts worth A$31.9 million, the Defence Department said on Tuesday.
The department said it had awarded a A$30 million contract to Transfield Defence Systems Pty Ltd to upgrade 364 of the vehicles.
Transfield Pty Ltd had been awarded a A$1.9 million contract last week to enhance the protection of crew and passengers from metal splinters, the department said in a statement.
Transfield is a privately-owned engineering group.
The contracts were part of the A$50 million M113 upgrade project designed to keep the vehicles, introduced in 1964, in service until 2010.
The upgraded vehicles were due for delivery between mid-1998 and late 1999 and early 2000, the department said.
